_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source preset(s) for paperless-ngx-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Syncs Paperless-ngx documents into the KG as :Document nodes carrying OCR text via the paperless-ngx-mcp MCP server. Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS. The native paperless_ingest_documents tool (kg_ingest.py) is the richer path — it also emits :Correspondent/:Tag/:DocumentType links and (optionally) scanned-PDF blobs.
